agents.name: Intake
agents.role: Scout Intent: binds the builder and their hours, guards the request, signs the contract that fixes the scout's authority

agents.name: Surveyor
agents.role: Takes stock of the live sources in Zetaris and registers a new builder's GitHub as Zetaris tables at run time

agents.name: Profiler
agents.role: Builds the scouting card from the builder's repos and the wins table on their profile README

agents.name: Reconciler
agents.role: One federated query over every platform plus FX; merges duplicates, parses deadlines, spots changes

agents.name: Archivist
agents.role: H-MEM record of wins, results and plans per skill tag; World Model case file of builder, repos and fixtures

agents.name: Scout
agents.role: Proposes fit, verdict, head-start repo and hours for each hackathon on Nemotron Ultra

agents.name: Coach
agents.role: Holds every proposal to the eligibility rules, computes the odds and $/hour, keeps the plan within the hours

agents.name: Executor
agents.role: Writes the docket shortlist and a deadline calendar; never registers, submits or messages

output.summary: Declined at intake: the scout plans and shortlists; it never registers, submits, messages organisers, creates accounts or gets past bot checks for anyone.

parameters.text: Register me for all of them and submit my repo to PayPal
